cases.name: Software patent invalidated by a 2018 arXiv paper

citations_matched: "BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers."
"the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference"
verdict.consensus_reasoning: The source expressly discloses each claim element in the same arrangement: pre-training a deep bidirectional transformer language model from unlabeled text using left and right context in all layers, then fine-tuning with one added output layer for question answering or language inference. The BERT paper is a full technical disclosure enabling skilled practitioners.

cases.name: Hardware architecture: cited prior art post-dates priority, bond slashed

citations_matched: "deployed in datacenters since 2015 that accelerates the inference phase of neural networks (NN)"
"The heart of the TPU is a 65,536 8-bit MAC matrix multiply unit"
verdict.consensus_reasoning: The source clearly discloses an NN inference accelerator with an 8-bit MAC matrix multiply unit and on-chip memory. However, the provided text does not expressly disclose a systolic array, a unified buffer holding input activations, a weight FIFO staging weights, or accumulators collecting array output arranged as claimed. The excerpt is also too high-level to be enabling for the full claimed architecture.
Source unreachable or returned no readable content.
